Before you go further:
[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/dravensoft-dev/arena/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) sets out
which contributions Arena accepts and which it does not, and it is worth reading
first, because it decides whether this pull request can go anywhere.

If what you found is a defect, the issue forms are where it gets acted on, and
the description you have already written here is most of one.

moved, which contract or gate holds it, and what `bun run check` says.
